summary: Backend dashboard and all collection CRUD flows passed. Desktop navigation and forms work; mobile navigation is inaccessible and cash modal title is blank.

ui_bugs.issue: At viewport 390px, CSS hides every inactive nav item and provides no menu/expand control, so users cannot navigate away from the current section.
Opening a new cash record displays an empty h2 because the modal title mapping omits cash.

action_items: Add a mobile menu or keep navigation items visible/scrollable at widths below 700px.
Add a cash title such as 'Yeni kasa kaydı' to the modal title mapping.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend fallback/demo values are intentionally MOCKED when MongoDB has no records or API fails; this was confirmed in the implementation and should remain clearly distinguished from persisted data.
The table layout hardcodes three grid columns while staff renders four fields; verify staff table alignment on desktop during the next UI pass.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ API records and one temporary cash UI record; all were deleted after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop core flows passed. Recheck mobile navigation after adding a menu/visible nav, cash modal title, and staff four-column table alignment.
rca of the issue: Mobile CSS rule .nav-item:not(.active){display:none} removes all navigation targets without a replacement control. Cash modal title uses a mapping object that includes sales, expenses, inventory, and staff but not cash, yielding undefined text.
